# Check reports which layer failed during composition.

# Make the script executable so the failure comes from running the operation.
mkdir definition/layers
mv give/layer definition/layers/0001-fail
cd definition
git init -q -b main
chmod 0755 layers/0001-fail/fail.sh

! exec layerctl check
stderr '0001-fail'
stderr 'fail\.sh'

-- give/layer/layer.toml --
[vcs]
commit-msg = "Fail the check"

[[operation]]
[operation.script]
file = "fail.sh"
-- give/layer/fail.sh --
#!/bin/sh
printf '%s: intentional failure\n' "${0##*/}" >&2
exit 23
